reply.text:
This is a symptom after a head impact, and I won't weigh in on it. A headache and fogginess after a blow to the head is one for a doctor, and please get it looked at soon rather than waiting it out. If you start feeling worse, get confusion, vomiting, trouble staying awake, or any change in vision or balance, go to urgent care or the ER right away.

Please also stay out of sparring and any hard training until a doctor has cleared you. Once you have that clearance, tell me what they said and I'll build around it. I'm here for the training side whenever you're ready.
